page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The processor is an Intel Xeon 8269CY. With a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, avoiding resource sharing at the thread level.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring dedicated compute resources and a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, multi-threaded processing, and web serving workloads that benefit from dedicated Intel Xeon cores without hyperthreading.
